action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add testID props on /admin/quota-editor inputs/buttons/toggles and on /admin/catalog L0 icon buttons (Add/Edit/Delete) for stable Playwright selectors.

(Cache note) When you ship a new route under /app/admin/*, also bounce expo (sudo supervisorctl restart expo) because Metro is in CI mode (reloads disabled) and pre-existing tunnels can briefly serve a stale routes manifest — the testing agent had to restart expo once before /admin/quota-editor resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin_quota.py is well-structured (~407 LOC). _can_edit_quota correctly gates super_admin and (admin|co_admin)+can_edit_quota=true. _require_quota/_require_super refetch the user doc so a freshly-granted admin sees the new flag without re-login.

POST /lookup correctly requires email AND mobile to belong to the same account via the {whatsapp_number, phone, mobile} set — a stronger identity proof than email alone, and returns mobile_masked, not the raw number — good PII hygiene.

/request-otp upserts hashed code keyed by actor_user_id+target_user_id (TTL 10 min, max 5 attempts) and ships the OTP to the FIRST super_admin with a usable whatsapp_number — sensible default. Returns dev_code only when WA_OTP_EXPOSE_DEV_CODE=true OR send failed — matches the existing WA OTP convention. ⚠️ Minor: OTP is keyed only on actor_user_id (target lives in the same doc); calling request-otp for a different target overwrites the previous one — fine for UX, just worth noting.

/apply: collapses multiple active entitlement rows into ONE canonical row (keeps row[0], archives the rest with status='archived_admin_edit') — preserves audit history while reconciling the granted/consumed/balance math (new_granted = consumed + new_left). Also inserts a fresh row if the user had none — that's why the harden_1777921741 top-up worked despite the user having no whatsapp_number on file. Writes immutable quota_admin_log entry + best-effort WA + email notifications, then deletes the OTP (one-time use).

routes/decisions.py clone path (line 173) now calls ensure_decision_entitlement(user_id, module='dezider', decision_id=new_id) inside a try/except — same pattern as create + template-use. swot.py:496 and pros_cons.py:289 also call consume on convert. The 'consumption only on main decision create' bug is fixed across clone, template-use, swot-convert and pros_cons-convert.

/admin/catalog index.tsx — L0 rows now show editable=true coming from the backend (lvl>=1 only, but POST /nodes derives new_level from parent so + on L0 creates an L1) — combined with the lvl>=0 editable rule on L0 in catalog_explorer.py, super admin can rename/delete/add even life areas. UI confirmed renders pencil+trash+plus on all 10 L0 rows.

MarketingHeader.tsx — brand <Text numberOfLines={1} adjustsFontSizeToFit minimumFontScale={0.8}> with a brandTextWrap maxWidth:360 wrapper keeps 'JELCOS AI' on a single line; verified at 1280px and 375px viewports.
